name: ID camera layout
owner: native app team (Android + iOS): the screen opened by the JS bridge method startOcrCapture(cardType, desc, callbackName)
notInH5: phi_h5_025 does not draw this screen. src/pages/AuthPage/Identity/index.tsx handleCameraUpload(side) -> src/utils/jsbridge/media.ts openNativeCameraCapture(cardType) -> bridge.startOcrCapture(cardType, '', callbackName). Nothing in the H5 repo changes.
decided: 2026-11-25, design owner: lay the ID camera out like CashSaya's ID camera, keep PeraSure's look and pieces
units: dp (Android) = pt (iOS) = design px at 360 wide; nothing is scaled with the screen except where a rule says so
orientation: the phone stays in portrait; the content is laid out for an ID held sideways: title, box and hint form one column that is rotated 90 degrees clockwise (title ends up on the right, hint on the left, both reading top to bottom)

layers.name: camera preview
layers.rule: full screen behind everything, aspect-fill (object-fit: cover)

layers.name: dim
layers.rule: everything outside the box: #000000 at 60 % over the preview; inside the box: clear

layers.name: box
layers.rule: see geometry; stroke 2.5 inside, #FFFFFF (fg/on-emphasis); corner radius 8 (radius/xs); no fill

layers.name: side title
layers.rule: ID card icon 28 + gap 12 + text; icon and text #298648 (fg/accent); text Title/sm = Hanken Grotesk Bold 18 / line 24, letter-spacing -1 %; one line

layers.name: hint
layers.rule: Body/sm = Hanken Grotesk Regular 12 / line 16, #FFFFFF, centred; one line; if it is longer than the box's long side (large system font) it wraps inside that length

layers.name: back button
layers.rule: 40 circle, fill #FFFFFF at 20 % (bg/glass-on-dark), chevron-left 18 #FFFFFF rotated 90 degrees clockwise (points up); right 16, top = status bar + 16. Unchanged

layers.name: shutter
layers.rule: 60: 3 ring #FFFFFF, 3 gap, 48 disc #FFFFFF; centred; bottom = navigation bar + 56. Unchanged

geometry.view: the space the box centres in: top = back button bottom + 24 (= status bar + 16 + 40 + 24); bottom = shutter top - 24 (= screen height - navigation bar - 56 - 60 - 24)
geometry.shortSide: S = min(screenWidth - 2*edge - 2*line - 2*gap, viewHeight / ratio)   // S is the box's width on screen
geometry.longSide: L = S * ratio   // the box's height on screen (ID-1 card: 85.6 x 53.98 mm)
geometry.box: centred in the view: x = (screenWidth - S) / 2, y = view.top + (viewHeight - L) / 2
geometry.sideTitle: right of the box, gap 4 from the box's right edge, in a 28-wide lane; centred along the box's long side
geometry.hint: left of the box, gap 4 from the box's left edge; its 28-wide lane mirrors the title's, the text sits against the box side of the lane; centred along the box's long side
geometry.line: both text lanes are 28 wide so the box stays centred even though the hint is only 16 tall

examples.screen: 360 x 749, status bar 40, no navigation bar (Figma frame)
360 x 640, status bar 40 (short screen: the height limits the box)

copy.hint: Make sure every detail is clear and the whole ID fits in the box.
copy.note: The hint replaces the longer 'Please make sure that all the details are clear and the whole ID fits in the box' so it fits on one line.

before: Old design (Figma before 2026-11-25): a fixed 259 x 382 box starting 184 from the top, hint wrapped over two lines.
unchanged: capture, OCR, upload and callback behaviour
cardType frame selection (UMID / TIN / SSS / default) — every card type uses the same ID-1 box
back button and shutter look and position
open: The H5 page does not tell the native camera which side it is taking (openNativeCameraCapture(cardType) has no side). If the native screen cannot know front / back, keep its current title; passing the side (for example through desc) would be an H5 behaviour change, not in this package.
